heading: 16.3 Expected import patterns
text:
### 16.3 Expected import patterns [LUNI.16.3]

Each library takes its own `import` statement. A file combining the SI base with one domain library reads:

| Context | Libraries |
|---|---|
| scientific / embedded — most files | `units.si` |
| European engineering | `units.si`, `units.metric` |
| US engineering | `units.si`, `units.customary` |
| adds CGS EM units (gauss, maxwell) | `units.si`, `units.electrical` |
| motor / thermal / fluid / radiation work | `units.si`, `units.physics` |
| US mass-heavy context | `units.customary`, `units.avoirdupois` |
| cross-region product | `units.customary`, `units.imperial` |
| lab / sensor chemistry | `units.si`, `units.chemistry` |
| DSP / audio processing | `units.si`, `units.audio` |
| marine / aviation | `units.si`, `units.nautical` |
| telescope / spacecraft telemetry | `units.si`, `units.astro` |
| firmware / embedded comms budget | `units.si`, `units.computer` |

The commas above separate library names in prose, not source. `units.imperial`
has no length dimension — `units.customary` provides inch/foot/yard/mile for
both regions.
